jobs.title: Senior Implementation Consultant - Board EPM
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Implementation Consultant - Board EPM based in United States.

This is a hands-on consulting opportunity for an experienced EPM professional who enjoys turning complex financial planning processes into scalable technology solutions. You will lead end-to-end implementations of Board EPM, working closely with enterprise clients from discovery and requirements gathering through deployment and user enablement. The role combines strong FP&A knowledge with functional design, solution configuration, and client-facing consulting. You will facilitate workshops, translate business needs into effective models, and help clients modernize budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and reporting. Beyond project delivery, you will contribute to improving implementation methodologies and mentoring other consultants. This is a fully remote role offering the opportunity to work with a high-growth EPM practice and enterprise organizations across North America.

Accountabilities

Lead EPM implementations: Own end-to-end Board EPM projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and user enablement.
Translate FP&A processes: Convert budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, reporting, and performance-management requirements into scalable Board models and functional solutions.
Facilitate client discovery: Lead workshops, discovery sessions, and process-design interviews to understand business requirements and identify opportunities for improvement.
Manage delivery: Coordinate project timelines, deliverables, priorities, and client expectations to ensure successful and timely implementation outcomes.
Collaborate across teams: Partner with project management, solution architecture, technical, and other delivery teams to align functional requirements and implementation activities.
Develop client materials: Create executive-level documentation, dashboards, training resources, and other materials that support adoption and ongoing use of implemented solutions.
Drive continuous improvement: Contribute to delivery methodologies, reusable accelerators, implementation best practices, and improvements to the overall consulting approach.
Support team development: Share expertise and mentor other consultants, helping strengthen functional knowledge, delivery quality, and Board EPM capabilities across the practice.

Requirements

Board EPM expertise: At least 4 years of experience implementing Board EPM solutions within a consulting environment is required.
FP&A background: Strong practical experience with financial planning and analysis, including corporate budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, consolidation, and performance reporting.
Financial expertise: Solid understanding of managerial accounting and the financial processes that underpin enterprise planning and performance management.
Functional design: Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into clear, scalable functional system designs.
Data and modeling: Strong Excel skills and experience with data modeling and structured financial analysis.
Consulting skills: Proven ability to work directly with clients, facilitate workshops, manage expectations, and navigate complex business requirements.
Communication: Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
Ownership: A delivery-focused mindset with strong organization, problem-solving capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Preferred qualifications: Board certification, SQL or scripting experience, and experience working with enterprise clients are strong advantages.
Work authorization: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada without current or future employer sponsorship.

Benefits

Competitive consulting opportunity: Join a high-growth EPM practice delivering modern planning and performance-management solutions to enterprise clients.
Fully remote: Work remotely from anywhere in Canada or the United States.
Professional growth: Opportunity to expand expertise in Board EPM, enterprise financial transformation, and consulting.
Mentorship opportunities: Play an influential role in developing other consultants and contributing to the growth of the EPM practice.
Enterprise exposure: Work on complex client engagements involving modern financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and performance-management processes.
Innovation and impact: Contribute to implementation methodologies, reusable accelerators, and improvements that enhance delivery quality and efficiency.

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Implementation Consultant based in United States.

This is a customer-facing consulting role focused on helping large retail organizations translate business challenges into effective technology solutions.

You will combine retail expertise, solution architecture, and consultative skills to guide customers through their transformation journeys.

The role spans discovery, solution design, demonstrations, scoping, implementation guidance, and strategic roadmap development.

You will work closely with sales, customer success, product, engineering, and project teams to create aligned and practical solutions.

As a trusted advisor, you will engage stakeholders ranging from operational practitioners to C-suite executives.

Your recommendations will help customers improve adoption, operational performance, and measurable business outcomes.

The position is remote, with travel of up to 30% for customer meetings, sales events, and industry activities.

Accountabilities

Engage directly with customers and sales teams to understand business objectives, operational challenges, requirements, and desired outcomes, translating these insights into well-structured solution recommendations.
Oversee and advise on platform implementations, providing technical and business leadership throughout the customer journey and helping reduce implementation risks through proven best practices.
Lead discovery and design sessions, document business requirements, identify gaps, and develop future-state visions, solution architectures, configurations, and actionable execution plans.
Deliver compelling product demonstrations and presentations that communicate business value, measurable outcomes, competitive advantages, and potential return on investment rather than focusing solely on product features.
Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives and practitioners, providing thought leadership, implementation guidance, best practices, and forward-looking roadmaps that support adoption and growth.
Partner with sales and account teams to develop business cases, scope statements of work, define project deliverables, lead scoping discussions, and recommend appropriate solutions and project boundaries.
Collaborate with internal product, engineering, project, and customer success teams to ensure proposed solutions are aligned, clearly documented, and successfully transitioned for delivery.
Maintain strong subject matter expertise across the platform and customer journey, staying current on product enhancements, retail industry trends, competitive intelligence, and emerging customer needs.
Maintain and enhance demonstration environments and scenarios to effectively showcase new capabilities and relevant customer use cases.
Participate in team meetings, workshops, sales events, trade shows, and other customer-facing activities as required, including travel of up to 30%.

Requirements

Bring 3+ years of relevant experience in solutions consulting, sales consulting, presales, implementation consulting, or a comparable customer-facing SaaS role, ideally supporting large enterprise customers.
Demonstrate experience in retail operations, enterprise technology, or SaaS environments, with a strong understanding of retail systems and business processes.
Possess in-depth knowledge of multiple retail enterprise solutions, particularly areas such as POS, OMS, Sales Audit, CRM/Loyalty, Merchandising, Allocation & Replenishment, and Analytics.
Have experience preparing customer presentations and RFP responses, delivering scripted and unscripted software demonstrations, developing business cases, leading discovery sessions, and/or supporting implementation initiatives.
Demonstrate strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and confidently to audiences ranging from practitioners to C-suite executives.
Bring strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to design practical solutions that address specific customer requirements while leveraging available platform capabilities.
Be highly customer-focused, proactive, and comfortable acting as a trusted advisor while balancing customer needs with business and technical considerations.
Demonstrate strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across sales, customer success, product, engineering, project, and customer teams.
Be capable of translating business requirements into solution architectures, implementation recommendations, roadmaps, and actionable plans.
Maintain a strong understanding of CRM, marketing automation, business intelligence, analytics, and related digital technologies.
Be comfortable working independently in a remote environment while participating actively in virtual and in-person meetings and workshops.
Be willing to travel up to approximately 30%, primarily by air, for customer engagements, sales activities, and industry events.
Be comfortable conducting customer and internal meetings with video enabled.

Benefits

Remote work from United States.
Base salary plus commission, providing an opportunity to earn additional compensation based on performance.
Opportunity to influence enterprise technology initiatives and help large retail organizations achieve measurable operational and business outcomes.
Exposure to complex customer environments and opportunities to work with senior business and technology stakeholders.
A collaborative, customer-focused environment centered on accountability, innovation, excellence, and action.
Opportunities to expand expertise across retail operations, SaaS solutions, implementation, solution architecture, and consultative selling.
Participation in customer meetings, industry events, trade shows, and professional workshops.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together.

Join us on our mission to make a better world of work.

Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.

Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.

For more information visit cultureamp.com.

Join us in creating a better world of work.

We’re seeking a Senior Customer Success Manager to support our Enterprise customers (1,000+ users) through strategic partnership, proactive risk management, and value-led customer success.

Working within our new GTM pod model, you’ll partner closely with Sales and Renewals to align on account strategy, deliver a coordinated customer experience, and own customer outcomes.

What You Will Do

Own a strategic Enterprise portfolio: Manage 40-55 Enterprise customers totalling $3.5M - $4M ARR, with accountability for retention, adoption, expansion, and clear book ownership.
Drive commercial outcomes: Manage GRR and NRR through bi-annual Executive Strategy Reviews, adoption planning, proactive risk management, and CSQL creation.
Identify and act on risk early: Drive risk mitigation plans with urgency and sound judgment, especially through moments like lost sponsors, stalled adoption, and changing customer priorities.
Lead strategic customer conversations: Connect customer priorities to measurable business value, strengthen executive relationships (CHROs, CPOs, etc.), and validate renewal intent.
Operate within the GTM pod model: Partner closely with Sales, Renewal Managers, and pod leaders in a co-led Sales and CX model that owns the full customer revenue lifecycle across adopt, expand, and renew.
Leverage automated plays: Use digitally-led customer motion and automation to surface opportunity and risk, and create consistency across your book.
Use AI to improve scale and focus: Use AI-enabled tools and workflows to prepare for customer conversations, surface insights, reduce manual work, and spend more time on strategic engagement.
Improve the system and raise the bar: Maintain strong account hygiene in Vitally and related tools, share customer feedback, and contribute ideas and playbooks that strengthen our broader CX and GTM practice.

What You Bring

Ideally 3 years of experience in enterprise customer success or account management roles, with a focus on AI-forward solutions and experience in driving adoption, change management, and executive stakeholder engagement.
A track record of owning GRR and NRR while balancing customer outcomes with commercial accountability.
Strong executive communication skills and the ability to lead data-informed, value-based conversations.
A proactive approach to risk management, strong customer and product curiosity, and sound judgment in high-stakes situations.
The ability to collaborate effectively across functions and operate with high accountability in a pod-based model.
Comfort using AI as a practical tool to synthesize information, improve prioritization, and increase the quality and consistency of customer engagement.

After 3 months, you’ll:

Independently own GRR and NRR across your Enterprise book of business.
Work effectively within your GTM pod and contribute to coordinated account strategy across adopt, expand, and renew.
Deliver key customer moments with strong preparation, value-led storytelling, and clear follow-through.
Proactively manage customer health, adoption, and risk across your accounts using DLCX and scaled workflows where appropriate.
Build strong product knowledge and connect Culture Amp’s platform to customer goals.
Use AI-supported workflows to streamline account planning, uncover customer signals, and improve the consistency of book management.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is listed below. In addition to base salary, your compensation package will include additional components such as equity and benefits. For sales roles, your package may also include sales commission

The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual skills, capabilities and experience, objectively assessed during the interview process. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We believe in fair & equitable pay at Culture Amp, and therefore, we build pay equity into all our programs in addition to conducting annual pay equity audits.

Base Salary Range (US)

$131,000 - $150,000 USD

Perks & Benefits

At Culture Amp, our people are at the heart of our success. We offer competitive pay and a total rewards package designed to support you at work and in life. This includes:

Equity through our Employee Share Option Program, so you can share in our long-term success
Learning programs and coaching to help you thrive and grow
Quarterly refresh days, an extended end-of-year break and a monthly allowance to support your wellbeing and lifestyle
Inclusive parental leave from day one
A MacBook and budget to set up your home workspace, enabling flexibility
Five annual social impact days to to give back to causes that matter to you
Medical insurance coverage for you and your family (Available for US & UK only)

Our rewards are designed to support different needs and life stages, recognising that what matters most can vary from person to person.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement, but your unique experience matters. If you’re interested in joining us, we strongly encourage you to apply and help us build a more diverse and impactful team.

Accommodations & Data Privacy

If you require reasonable accommodations or adjustments due to a disability to complete the online application or to participate in the interview process, please contact accommodations@cultureamp.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Culture Amp will retain your CV & personal information for a period of two years (four years for the US) from the date of your application process completion. Culture Amp may contact you in relation to future job opportunities during this time period. For further information please see our privacy policy here or contact privacy@cultureamp.com.

jobs.description:
Company Profile:
AppCard Inc. is a technology and marketing company headquartered in Manhattan, NY. Appcard has a powerful marketing tool that leverages data acquired at the point of sale (POS) via an advanced rewards program to create advanced retargeting campaigns that help businesses increase their bottom line. AppCard is unique in the loyalty space due to its patented technology which allows businesses to capture shopper identity and item level data in realtime from purchases made in store and online. The benefit of this is two fold: consumers benefit by receiving offers, incentives and coupons. Through a shopper’s interactions with the former AppCard’s platform records and learns shopper behavior and gives grocers the ability to make their data actionable to increase average basket size and systematically increase repeat purchases.

About the Role:
AppCard is looking for a business oriented, tech savvy Customer Success Manager to deliver loyalty marketing solutions to our clients. This role will allow you to position our industry leading products and execute data-driven marketing strategies to our largest clients.

Responsibilities
Train clients on how to use the AppCard platform
Serve as a trusted consultant with clients to optimize their loyalty and marketing strategy
Become a product expert in the AppCard platform to best leverage AppCard’s product offering
Monitor usage and product adoption, proactively contact clients to deliver coaching/training to improve their utilization
Understand how to build and present AppCard’s value using data and insights
Drive growth within existing clients, identify upsell opportunities and generate new revenue
Understand, adapt to, and help build AppCard’s ongoing product and technology developments
Develop and execute data-driven campaigns and in-store promotions
Assist clients with basic troubleshooting on various software and hardware issues that may arise
Work cross-functionally with implementation, development, finance, tech support, product and marketing

Requirements:
1-3 years years of experience
Customer oriented
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Experience managing complex software/hardware implementation projects
Tech Savvy; basic understanding of front end vs. backend
Understanding of retail business needs a plus
Fast and autonomous learner
Provide technical and product support
Advantage: experience in either – account management, customer success, professional services, SAAS / Tech industry experience
Advantage: experience using SalesForce, JIRA, BI tools such as Cognos/SiSense/other, Excel, and G-Suite
Grocery industry experience preferred

This is a customer-facing consulting role focused on helping large retail organizations translate business challenges into effective technology solutions.

You will combine retail expertise, solution architecture, and consultative skills to guide customers through their transformation journeys.

The role spans discovery, solution design, demonstrations, scoping, implementation guidance, and strategic roadmap development.

You will work closely with sales, customer success, product, engineering, and project teams to create aligned and practical solutions.

As a trusted advisor, you will engage stakeholders ranging from operational practitioners to C-suite executives.

Your recommendations will help customers improve adoption, operational performance, and measurable business outcomes.

The position is remote, with travel of up to 30% for customer meetings, sales events, and industry activities.

Accountabilities

Engage directly with customers and sales teams to understand business objectives, operational challenges, requirements, and desired outcomes, translating these insights into well-structured solution recommendations.
Oversee and advise on platform implementations, providing technical and business leadership throughout the customer journey and helping reduce implementation risks through proven best practices.
Lead discovery and design sessions, document business requirements, identify gaps, and develop future-state visions, solution architectures, configurations, and actionable execution plans.
Deliver compelling product demonstrations and presentations that communicate business value, measurable outcomes, competitive advantages, and potential return on investment rather than focusing solely on product features.
Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives and practitioners, providing thought leadership, implementation guidance, best practices, and forward-looking roadmaps that support adoption and growth.
Partner with sales and account teams to develop business cases, scope statements of work, define project deliverables, lead scoping discussions, and recommend appropriate solutions and project boundaries.
Collaborate with internal product, engineering, project, and customer success teams to ensure proposed solutions are aligned, clearly documented, and successfully transitioned for delivery.
Maintain strong subject matter expertise across the platform and customer journey, staying current on product enhancements, retail industry trends, competitive intelligence, and emerging customer needs.
Maintain and enhance demonstration environments and scenarios to effectively showcase new capabilities and relevant customer use cases.
Participate in team meetings, workshops, sales events, trade shows, and other customer-facing activities as required, including travel of up to 30%.

Requirements

Bring 3+ years of relevant experience in solutions consulting, sales consulting, presales, implementation consulting, or a comparable customer-facing SaaS role, ideally supporting large enterprise customers.
Demonstrate experience in retail operations, enterprise technology, or SaaS environments, with a strong understanding of retail systems and business processes.
Possess in-depth knowledge of multiple retail enterprise solutions, particularly areas such as POS, OMS, Sales Audit, CRM/Loyalty, Merchandising, Allocation & Replenishment, and Analytics.
Have experience preparing customer presentations and RFP responses, delivering scripted and unscripted software demonstrations, developing business cases, leading discovery sessions, and/or supporting implementation initiatives.
Demonstrate strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and confidently to audiences ranging from practitioners to C-suite executives.
Bring strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to design practical solutions that address specific customer requirements while leveraging available platform capabilities.
Be highly customer-focused, proactive, and comfortable acting as a trusted advisor while balancing customer needs with business and technical considerations.
Demonstrate strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across sales, customer success, product, engineering, project, and customer teams.
Be capable of translating business requirements into solution architectures, implementation recommendations, roadmaps, and actionable plans.
Maintain a strong understanding of CRM, marketing automation, business intelligence, analytics, and related digital technologies.
Be comfortable working independently in a remote environment while participating actively in virtual and in-person meetings and workshops.
Be willing to travel up to approximately 30%, primarily by air, for customer engagements, sales activities, and industry events.

new_jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
new_jobs.description:
We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together.

Join us on our mission to make a better world of work.

Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.

Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.

For more information visit cultureamp.com.

Join us in creating a better world of work.

We’re seeking a Senior Customer Success Manager to support our Enterprise customers (1,000+ users) through strategic partnership, proactive risk management, and value-led customer success.

Working within our new GTM pod model, you’ll partner closely with Sales and Renewals to align on account strategy, deliver a coordinated customer experience, and own customer outcomes.

What You Will Do

Own a strategic Enterprise portfolio: Manage 40-55 Enterprise customers totalling $3.5M - $4M ARR, with accountability for retention, adoption, expansion, and clear book ownership.
Drive commercial outcomes: Manage GRR and NRR through bi-annual Executive Strategy Reviews, adoption planning, proactive risk management, and CSQL creation.
Identify and act on risk early: Drive risk mitigation plans with urgency and sound judgment, especially through moments like lost sponsors, stalled adoption, and changing customer priorities.
Lead strategic customer conversations: Connect customer priorities to measurable business value, strengthen executive relationships (CHROs, CPOs, etc.), and validate renewal intent.
Operate within the GTM pod model: Partner closely with Sales, Renewal Managers, and pod leaders in a co-led Sales and CX model that owns the full customer revenue lifecycle across adopt, expand, and renew.
Leverage automated plays: Use digitally-led customer motion and automation to surface opportunity and risk, and create consistency across your book.
Use AI to improve scale and focus: Use AI-enabled tools and workflows to prepare for customer conversations, surface insights, reduce manual work, and spend more time on strategic engagement.
Improve the system and raise the bar: Maintain strong account hygiene in Vitally and related tools, share customer feedback, and contribute ideas and playbooks that strengthen our broader CX and GTM practice.

What You Bring

Ideally 3 years of experience in enterprise customer success or account management roles, with a focus on AI-forward solutions and experience in driving adoption, change management, and executive stakeholder engagement.
A track record of owning GRR and NRR while balancing customer outcomes with commercial accountability.
Strong executive communication skills and the ability to lead data-informed, value-based conversations.
A proactive approach to risk management, strong customer and product curiosity, and sound judgment in high-stakes situations.
The ability to collaborate effectively across functions and operate with high accountability in a pod-based model.
Comfort using AI as a practical tool to synthesize information, improve prioritization, and increase the quality and consistency of customer engagement.

After 3 months, you’ll:

Independently own GRR and NRR across your Enterprise book of business.
Work effectively within your GTM pod and contribute to coordinated account strategy across adopt, expand, and renew.
Deliver key customer moments with strong preparation, value-led storytelling, and clear follow-through.
Proactively manage customer health, adoption, and risk across your accounts using DLCX and scaled workflows where appropriate.
Build strong product knowledge and connect Culture Amp’s platform to customer goals.
Use AI-supported workflows to streamline account planning, uncover customer signals, and improve the consistency of book management.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is listed below. In addition to base salary, your compensation package will include additional components such as equity and benefits. For sales roles, your package may also include sales commission

The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual skills, capabilities and experience, objectively assessed during the interview process. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We believe in fair & equitable pay at Culture Amp, and therefore, we build pay equity into all our programs in addition to conducting annual pay equity audits.

Base Salary Range (US)

$131,000 - $150,000 USD

Perks & Benefits

At Culture Amp, our people are at the heart of our success. We offer competitive pay and a total rewards package designed to support you at work and in life. This includes:

Equity through our Employee Share Option Program, so you can share in our long-term success
Learning programs and coaching to help you thrive and grow
Quarterly refresh days, an extended end-of-year break and a monthly allowance to support your wellbeing and lifestyle
Inclusive parental leave from day one
A MacBook and budget to set up your home workspace, enabling flexibility
Five annual social impact days to to give back to causes that matter to you
Medical insurance coverage for you and your family (Available for US & UK only)

Our rewards are designed to support different needs and life stages, recognising that what matters most can vary from person to person.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement, but your unique experience matters. If you’re interested in joining us, we strongly encourage you to apply and help us build a more diverse and impactful team.

Accommodations & Data Privacy

If you require reasonable accommodations or adjustments due to a disability to complete the online application or to participate in the interview process, please contact accommodations@cultureamp.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Culture Amp will retain your CV & personal information for a period of two years (four years for the US) from the date of your application process completion. Culture Amp may contact you in relation to future job opportunities during this time period. For further information please see our privacy policy here or contact privacy@cultureamp.com.

new_jobs.description:
Company Profile:
AppCard Inc. is a technology and marketing company headquartered in Manhattan, NY. Appcard has a powerful marketing tool that leverages data acquired at the point of sale (POS) via an advanced rewards program to create advanced retargeting campaigns that help businesses increase their bottom line. AppCard is unique in the loyalty space due to its patented technology which allows businesses to capture shopper identity and item level data in realtime from purchases made in store and online. The benefit of this is two fold: consumers benefit by receiving offers, incentives and coupons. Through a shopper’s interactions with the former AppCard’s platform records and learns shopper behavior and gives grocers the ability to make their data actionable to increase average basket size and systematically increase repeat purchases.

About the Role:
AppCard is looking for a business oriented, tech savvy Customer Success Manager to deliver loyalty marketing solutions to our clients. This role will allow you to position our industry leading products and execute data-driven marketing strategies to our largest clients.

Responsibilities
Train clients on how to use the AppCard platform
Serve as a trusted consultant with clients to optimize their loyalty and marketing strategy
Become a product expert in the AppCard platform to best leverage AppCard’s product offering
Monitor usage and product adoption, proactively contact clients to deliver coaching/training to improve their utilization
Understand how to build and present AppCard’s value using data and insights
Drive growth within existing clients, identify upsell opportunities and generate new revenue
Understand, adapt to, and help build AppCard’s ongoing product and technology developments
Develop and execute data-driven campaigns and in-store promotions
Assist clients with basic troubleshooting on various software and hardware issues that may arise
Work cross-functionally with implementation, development, finance, tech support, product and marketing

Requirements:
1-3 years years of experience
Customer oriented
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Experience managing complex software/hardware implementation projects
Tech Savvy; basic understanding of front end vs. backend
Understanding of retail business needs a plus
Fast and autonomous learner
Provide technical and product support
Advantage: experience in either – account management, customer success, professional services, SAAS / Tech industry experience
Advantage: experience using SalesForce, JIRA, BI tools such as Cognos/SiSense/other, Excel, and G-Suite
Grocery industry experience preferred
